name: 32770-moelora-qwen3moe30b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of one a3 node, one tensor-parallel group.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, `fully_sharded_loras` at its default (off). TP=2 is forced by memory, not chosen: two resident rank-64 slots add ~13.3 GB of stacked LoRA buffers on top of ~57 GiB of weights, which does not leave one 80 GB card room for a working set needing ~8.2 GiB of KV.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 48 layers, hidden 2048, 128 experts with 8 active per token, moe_intermediate_size 768, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, bfloat16, ~30.5B params (~57 GiB). Read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=80, bounded at 800 requests, warmup 160 and cooldown 80 requests -- both absolute counts carrying an explicit `mode: requests`, leaving a measured window of 560 requests = 7 waves; `safety_seconds: 1800` is a runaway guard, not a bound.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets, no tools: fixed-shape random-token requests, 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 100 output tokens, both pinned min=max, with `max_tokens=100` and `ignore_eos=True` so every request emits exactly 100 tokens. `request_format: plain` sends the sampled tokens with no chat template, so the wire prompt is the declared 1024. Greedy (temperature 0.0). Every request carries an adapter, alternating over the two declared names.
purpose: A mixture-of-experts chat assistant with two LoRA personas, serving 80 concurrent 1k-token prompts across two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 61274bdef58ed6e0ab194d33d3f82de331d0e0d4 (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.14.0rc1-342-g61274bdef5). Nothing here is tuned.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 2

# LoRA serving is the setup: every request carries an adapter. The adapter names are declared
# client-side in scenario.json, because `--lora-modules` is an API-server argument while every
# key in this file goes straight into AsyncEngineArgs.
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 2

# NOT tracked to the substituted adapter, which is r=8 and is zero-padded into a rank-64 slot.
# max_lora_rank sizes the stacked LoRA buffers, so declaring 8 would run a problem eight times
# narrower.
max-lora-rank: 64

enable-prefix-caching: false

# Pinned rather than redundant: an in-process engine build gets UsageContext.ENGINE_CONTEXT,
# which is in neither per-context defaults table, so an unpinned run falls through to 2048 / 128
# instead of the 8192 / 1024 a `vllm serve` path resolves to on this card.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
